title: Example multi-wave workstream
summary: Wave 1 is complete; this dogfood workstream now tracks the next project-tracker loop around keeping the local artifact current, restoring recent movement, and promoting later-wave nodes into fresh issues.

nodes.title: Bootstrap the local workstream artifact
nodes.summary: Create the repo-local ignored workstream home and seed this project-tracker effort as the first durable dogfood workstream.

nodes.title: Create the read-only project-tracker surface
nodes.summary: Load the seeded artifact in a dedicated per-workstream surface without redefining the model in the UI layer.

nodes.title: Enrich with GitHub state and derived status
nodes.summary: Layer GitHub issue and PR state onto the seeded workstream so the command center can show ready, blocked, and review movement without manual synthesis.

nodes.title: Complete the first dogfood wave
nodes.summary: Treat the initial bootstrap, read-only surface, and GitHub enrichment as the first coherent loop before expanding into runtime overlays or richer graph UX.

nodes.title: Ship plugin-distributed workstream authoring skill
nodes.summary: Let orchestrator agents create and update local .workstreams documents through repo-backed helpers and plugin distribution instead of tracked seeded workstream content.

nodes.title: Add a safe local update workflow for the workstream artifact
nodes.summary: Establish a safe local update workflow for the command center, starting with a plugin-distributed authoring skill instead of tracked seeded workstream content.

nodes.title: Add recent movement and local history
nodes.summary: Recover the missing movement timeline so the command center shows what changed since the last time the operator looked.

nodes.title: Support wave-based issue grounding and promotion
nodes.summary: Let the graph hold future work durably, then promote selected nodes into fresh GitHub issues without rewriting the plan from scratch.

nodes.title: Complete the second dogfood wave
nodes.summary: Treat safe local updates, recent movement, and wave-based issue promotion as the next coherent loop before session overlays or richer topology work.

nodes.title: Add first-class workstream brief support
nodes.summary: Extend the workstream artifact contract so a workstream can explicitly reference narrative/context documents alongside JSON graph state and wave execution data.

checkpoints.title: Shape the first dogfood wave
checkpoints.summary: Parent issue #124 and the workstream project-tracker note define the first artifact-first wave and keep runtime overlays out of scope.

checkpoints.title: Bootstrap the local workstream home

checkpoints.title: Prove the read-only project-tracker loop
checkpoints.summary: Use the seeded artifact to drive a separate workstream surface before adding runtime overlays or mutation paths.

checkpoints.title: Derive GitHub-backed operational state

checkpoints.title: Shape the second dogfood wave

checkpoints.title: Operationalize local workstream updates

checkpoints.title: Promote future nodes into fresh execution issues
